phoneticConvention: English approximation in the style of the Melunga deck (phe field): dway-boo-chee = 对不起, may gwahn-shee = 没关系, ching = 请. Syllables of one word are joined with hyphens, words are separated by spaces. Tones are not shown: see the pinyin (reading field) and the audio. Standard Mandarin, simplified characters.
reviewStatus: Written by rule from validated content; native English review recommended. Linguistic review required (tones, naturalness of phrasing).
title: Nuancing and solving
goal: Rephrase, nuance and solve an unexpected problem.

model.note: 意思 = meaning, intention; 我的意思是… introduces a rephrasing. 太高了: 了 belongs to the exclamation pattern 太…了.

variants.study: 我的意思是价格太高了。

model.native: There's a problem: {s}. What should we do?
model.note: 怎么办 = 'what should we do?'. 丢了 / 取消了 / 忘在…了: 了 = it has happened, the situation has changed. 把 + object + verb brings the object forward (我把护照忘在酒店了).

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: 我不太确定来不来得及。有个问题：数据还不全。怎么办？
turns.reading: wǒ bú tài quèdìng lái bu láidejí. yǒu ge wèntí: shùjù hái bù quán. zěnme bàn?
turns.phon: woh boo teye chyweh-ding leye boo leye-duh-jee. yoh guh wun-tee: shoo-jyu heye boo chywen. dzun-muh bahn?
turns.native: I'm not sure I'll make it. There's a problem: the data isn't complete. What should we do?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: 那我们先交一部分吧，剩下的明天补。
turns.reading: nà wǒmen xiān jiāo yí bùfen ba, shèngxià de míngtiān bǔ.
turns.phon: nah woh-mun shyen jyow ee boo-fun bah, shung-shyah duh ming-tyen boo.
turns.native: Then let's hand in part of it first, and fill in the rest tomorrow.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: 好，我马上做。
turns.reading: hǎo, wǒ mǎshàng zuò.
turns.phon: how, woh mah-shahng dzwoh.
turns.native: Okay, I'll get on it right away.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

readiness: You can rephrase (我的意思是, 也就是说), soften (比较, 不太, 一部分), express uncertainty (可能, 我不确定 + V不V), explain a problem and ask for a way out (有个问题…怎么办), check your understanding (如果我没理解错) and suggest a solution (那我们…吧), including in travel, health and work situations.
